search_text: published ZDI-25-370 ZDI-CAN-25506 Trend Micro Endpoint Encryption PolicyServerWindowsService Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2025-06-11 CVE-2025-49213 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-49213 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Trend Micro'] ['Endpoint Encryption'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Trend Micro Endpoint Encryption. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the PolicyServerWindowsService class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Trend Micro has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Trend Micro Endpoint Encryption PolicyServerWindowsService Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Trend Micro Endpoint Encryption. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the PolicyServerWindowsService class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
